FROM ubuntu:22.04

ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

ENV GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null"

# Install dependencies
RUN apt-get update -y && \
    apt-get upgrade -y && \
    apt-get install -y software-properties-common curl zip unzip build-essential git && \
    apt-get clean && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Install sdkman
RUN curl -s "https://get.sdkman.io" | bash

# Ensure sdkman is sourced in all shells
RUN echo 'source "/root/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh"' >> /root/.bashrc && \
    echo 'source "/root/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh"' >> /root/.profile

# Install JVM tools via sdkman
RUN bash -c "source /root/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh && \
    sdk install java 8.0.412-zulu && \
    sdk install java 11.0.23-tem && \
    sdk install java 17.0.11-tem && \
    sdk install java 21.0.3-tem && \
    sdk default java 17.0.11-tem && \
    sdk install maven && \
    sdk install gradle && \
    sdk install kotlin"

# Set JAVA_HOME, add all tools to PATH
ENV JAVA_HOME="/root/.sdkman/candidates/java/current"
ENV PATH="/root/.sdkman/candidates/java/current/bin:/root/.sdkman/candidates/maven/current/bin:/root/.sdkman/candidates/gradle/current/bin:/root/.sdkman/candidates/kotlin/current/bin:${PATH}"

# Install Android SDK commandline-tools and basic packages
ENV ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="/opt/android-sdk"
ENV PATH="$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:$PATH"

RUN mkdir -p $ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools && \
    cd $ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools && \
    curl -o sdk.zip https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-11076708_latest.zip && \
    unzip sdk.zip -d . && \
    mv cmdline-tools latest && \
    rm sdk.zip && \
    yes | $ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --sdk_root=$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT "platform-tools" "platforms;android-34"

# Disable Gradle file system watching to prevent file watcher errors in Docker

RUN bash -c "source /root/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh && \
    sdk default java 11.0.23-tem"
# Create and set working directory
WORKDIR /root/agent-work


RUN bash -c "git init ."
RUN bash -c "git remote add origin git@github.com:neo4j/neo4j-java-driver.git"
RUN --mount=type=ssh bash -c "git fetch --depth 1 origin fbf1c89f00a73e04cd822bd264968dcfab37c136"
RUN bash -c "git checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD"
RUN bash -c "printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > patch.diff"
RUN bash -c "git apply patch.diff"
RUN bash -c "rm patch.diff"
RUN bash -c "printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > patch.diff"
RUN bash -c "git apply patch.diff"
RUN bash -c "rm patch.diff"
RUN bash -c "source ~/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh && sdk default java 17.0.11-tem"
RUN bash -c "java -version"
RUN bash -c "mvn install -pl driver -am -DskipTests"

FROM ubuntu:22.04

ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

ENV GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null"

# Install dependencies
RUN apt-get update -y && \
    apt-get upgrade -y && \
    apt-get install -y software-properties-common curl zip unzip build-essential git && \
    apt-get clean && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Install sdkman
RUN curl -s "https://get.sdkman.io" | bash

# Ensure sdkman is sourced in all shells
RUN echo 'source "/root/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh"' >> /root/.bashrc && \
    echo 'source "/root/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh"' >> /root/.profile

# Install JVM tools via sdkman
RUN bash -c "source /root/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh && \
    sdk install java 8.0.412-zulu && \
    sdk install java 11.0.23-tem && \
    sdk install java 17.0.11-tem && \
    sdk install java 21.0.3-tem && \
    sdk default java 17.0.11-tem && \
    sdk install maven && \
    sdk install gradle && \
    sdk install kotlin"

# Set JAVA_HOME, add all tools to PATH
ENV JAVA_HOME="/root/.sdkman/candidates/java/current"
ENV PATH="/root/.sdkman/candidates/java/current/bin:/root/.sdkman/candidates/maven/current/bin:/root/.sdkman/candidates/gradle/current/bin:/root/.sdkman/candidates/kotlin/current/bin:${PATH}"

# Install Android SDK commandline-tools and basic packages
ENV ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="/opt/android-sdk"
ENV PATH="$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:$PATH"

RUN mkdir -p $ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools && \
    cd $ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools && \
    curl -o sdk.zip https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-11076708_latest.zip && \
    unzip sdk.zip -d . && \
    mv cmdline-tools latest && \
    rm sdk.zip && \
    yes | $ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --sdk_root=$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT "platform-tools" "platforms;android-34"

    sdk default java 11.0.23-tem"
# Create and set working directory
WORKDIR /root/agent-work

RUN bash -c "git apply patch.diff"
RUN bash -c "rm patch.diff"

RUN bash -c "git apply patch.diff"
RUN bash -c "rm patch.diff"
RUN bash -c "source ~/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh && sdk default java 17.0.11-tem"
RUN bash -c "source ~/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh && java -version"

RUN bash -c "mvn test-compile -pl driver -am"

FROM ubuntu:22.04

ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

ENV GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null"

# Install dependencies
RUN apt-get update -y && \
    apt-get upgrade -y && \
    apt-get install -y software-properties-common curl zip unzip build-essential git && \
    apt-get clean && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Install sdkman
RUN curl -s "https://get.sdkman.io" | bash

# Ensure sdkman is sourced in all shells
RUN echo 'source "/root/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh"' >> /root/.bashrc && \
    echo 'source "/root/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh"' >> /root/.profile

# Install JVM tools via sdkman
RUN bash -c "source /root/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh && \
    sdk install java 8.0.412-zulu && \
    sdk install java 11.0.23-tem && \
    sdk install java 17.0.11-tem && \
    sdk install java 21.0.3-tem && \
    sdk default java 17.0.11-tem && \
    sdk install maven && \
    sdk install gradle && \
    sdk install kotlin"

# Set JAVA_HOME, add all tools to PATH
ENV JAVA_HOME="/root/.sdkman/candidates/java/current"
ENV PATH="/root/.sdkman/candidates/java/current/bin:/root/.sdkman/candidates/maven/current/bin:/root/.sdkman/candidates/gradle/current/bin:/root/.sdkman/candidates/kotlin/current/bin:${PATH}"

# Install Android SDK commandline-tools and basic packages
ENV ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="/opt/android-sdk"
ENV PATH="$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:$PATH"

RUN mkdir -p $ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools && \
    cd $ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools && \
    curl -o sdk.zip https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-11076708_latest.zip && \
    unzip sdk.zip -d . && \
    mv cmdline-tools latest && \
    rm sdk.zip && \
    yes | $ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --sdk_root=$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT "platform-tools" "platforms;android-34"

# Disable Gradle file system watching to prevent file watcher errors in Docker
ENV GRADLE_OPTS="-Dorg.gradle.vfs.watch=false"
RUN bash -c "source /root/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh && \
    sdk default java 11.0.23-tem"
# Create and set working directory
WORKDIR /root/agent-work


RUN bash -c "git init ."
RUN bash -c "git remote add origin git@github.com:neo4j/neo4j-java-driver.git"
RUN --mount=type=ssh bash -c "git fetch --depth 1 origin 19edf34a447ef9ca3901fcdde7c03e0d0b116dcc"
RUN bash -c "git checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD"
RUN bash -c "printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > patch.diff"
RUN bash -c "git apply patch.diff"
RUN bash -c "rm patch.diff"
RUN bash -c "printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > patch.diff"
RUN bash -c "git apply patch.diff"
RUN bash -c "rm patch.diff"
RUN bash -c "find . -name \"bolt-api-*\" -type d 2>/dev/null | head -20"
RUN bash -c "cat pom.xml | grep -A 5 \"<modules>\""
RUN bash -c "source ~/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh && sdk default java 17.0.11-tem"
RUN bash -c "java -version"
RUN bash -c "mvn install -pl driver -am -DskipTests"
RUN bash -c "mvn test -Dtest=org.neo4j.driver.ConfigTest -pl driver"
RUN bash -c "mvn test -Dtest=org.neo4j.driver.QueryConfigTest -pl driver"
RUN bash -c "mvn test -Dtest=org.neo4j.driver.internal.EagerResultTransformerTest -pl driver"
RUN bash -c "mvn test -Dtest=org.neo4j.driver.internal.InternalDriverTest -pl driver"
RUN cd /root/agent-work/driver && bash -c "mvn test -Dtest=org.neo4j.driver.ConfigTest"
RUN bash -c "mvn test -Dtest=org.neo4j.driver.QueryConfigTest -pl driver"
RUN bash -c "mvn test -Dtest=org.neo4j.driver.internal.EagerResultTransformerTest -pl driver"

FROM ubuntu:22.04

ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

ENV GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null"

# Install dependencies
RUN apt-get update -y && \
    apt-get upgrade -y && \
    apt-get install -y software-properties-common curl zip unzip build-essential git && \
    apt-get clean && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Install sdkman
RUN curl -s "https://get.sdkman.io" | bash

# Ensure sdkman is sourced in all shells
RUN echo 'source "/root/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh"' >> /root/.bashrc && \
    echo 'source "/root/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh"' >> /root/.profile

# Install JVM tools via sdkman
RUN bash -c "source /root/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh && \
    sdk install java 8.0.412-zulu && \
    sdk install java 11.0.23-tem && \
    sdk install java 17.0.11-tem && \
    sdk install java 21.0.3-tem && \
    sdk default java 17.0.11-tem && \
    sdk install maven && \
    sdk install gradle && \
    sdk install kotlin"

# Set JAVA_HOME, add all tools to PATH
ENV JAVA_HOME="/root/.sdkman/candidates/java/current"
ENV PATH="/root/.sdkman/candidates/java/current/bin:/root/.sdkman/candidates/maven/current/bin:/root/.sdkman/candidates/gradle/current/bin:/root/.sdkman/candidates/kotlin/current/bin:${PATH}"

# Install Android SDK commandline-tools and basic packages
ENV ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="/opt/android-sdk"
ENV PATH="$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:$PATH"

RUN mkdir -p $ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools && \
    cd $ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools && \
    curl -o sdk.zip https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-11076708_latest.zip && \
    unzip sdk.zip -d . && \
    mv cmdline-tools latest && \
    rm sdk.zip && \
    yes | $ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --sdk_root=$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT "platform-tools" "platforms;android-34"

# Disable Gradle file system watching to prevent file watcher errors in Docker
ENV GRADLE_OPTS="-Dorg.gradle.vfs.watch=false"
RUN bash -c "source /root/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh && \
    sdk default java 11.0.23-tem"
# Create and set working directory
WORKDIR /root/agent-work


RUN bash -c "git init ."
RUN bash -c "git remote add origin git@github.com:neo4j/neo4j-java-driver.git"
RUN --mount=type=ssh bash -c "git fetch --depth 1 origin 2532d448b962de888b835d1d3d3db2d87fd6b922"
RUN bash -c "git checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD"
RUN bash -c "printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > patch.diff"
RUN bash -c "git apply patch.diff"
RUN bash -c "rm patch.diff"
RUN bash -c "printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > patch.diff"
RUN bash -c "git apply patch.diff"
RUN bash -c "rm patch.diff"
RUN bash -c "source ~/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh && sdk default java 17.0.11-tem"
RUN bash -c "java -version"
RUN bash -c "mvn install -pl driver -am -DskipTests"
RUN bash -c "mvn test -Dtest=org.neo4j.driver.ConfigTest -pl driver"
RUN bash -c "mvn test -Dtest=org.neo4j.driver.internal.InternalDriverTest -pl driver"
RUN bash -c "git ls-files -z -- 'driver/clirr-ignored-differences.xml' 'driver/src/main/java/org/neo4j/driver/Config.java' 'driver/src/main/java/org/neo4j/driver/Driver.java' 'driver/src/main/java/org/neo4j/driver/EagerResult.java' 'driver/src/main/java/org/neo4j/driver/QueryConfig.java' 'driver/src/main/java/org/neo4j/driver/ResultTransformer.java' 'driver/src/main/java/org/neo4j/driver/RoutingControl.java' 'driver/src/main/java/org/neo4j/driver/internal/DriverFactory.java' 'driver/src/main/java/org/neo4j/driver/internal/EagerResultTransformer.java' 'driver/src/main/java/org/neo4j/driver/internal/EagerResultValue.java' 'driver/src/main/java/org/neo4j/driver/internal/InternalDriver.java' 'driver/src/main/java/org/neo4j/driver/internal/NoOpBookmarkManager.java' 'driver/src/main/java/org/neo4j/driver/internal/SessionFactoryImpl.java' 'testkit-backend/src/main/java/neo4j/org/testkit/backend/messages/requests/ResultConsume.java' 'testkit-backend/src/main/java/neo4j/org/testkit/backend/messages/requests/SummaryUtil.java' 'driver/src/test/java/org/neo4j/driver/ConfigTest.java' 'driver/src/test/java/org/neo4j/driver/QueryConfigTest.java' 'driver/src/test/java/org/neo4j/driver/internal/EagerResultTransformerTest.java' 'driver/src/test/java/org/neo4j/driver/internal/InternalDriverTest.java' 'driver/src/test/java/org/neo4j/driver/testutil/TestUtil.java' 'testkit-backend/src/main/java/neo4j/org/testkit/backend/messages/requests/ExecuteQuery.java' 'testkit-backend/src/main/java/neo4j/org/testkit/backend/messages/requests/GetFeatures.java' 'testkit-backend/src/main/java/neo4j/org/testkit/backend/messages/requests/TestkitRequest.java' 'testkit-backend/src/main/java/neo4j/org/testkit/backend/messages/responses/EagerResult.java'"

problem_statement:
Update Bookmark Manager for no longer tracking per database (#1335)

* Update Bookmark Manager for no longer tracking per database

BookmarkManager interface changes:
* The methods `getBookmarks` and `getAllBookmarks` were merge into `getBookmarks`.
* `forget` was removed.
* The database param was removed from the `updateBookmarks` method.

BookmarkManagerConfig changes:
* The BookmarksSupplier interface was replaced by Supplier<Set<Bookmark>>.
* The bookmarksConsumer changed its type to Consumer<Set<Bookmark>>.
* `initialBookmarks` changed its type to Set<Bookmark>

* Address suggestions from the review

FROM ubuntu:22.04

ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

ENV GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null"

# Install dependencies
RUN apt-get update -y && \
    apt-get upgrade -y && \
    apt-get install -y software-properties-common curl zip unzip build-essential git && \
    apt-get clean && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Install sdkman
RUN curl -s "https://get.sdkman.io" | bash

# Ensure sdkman is sourced in all shells
RUN echo 'source "/root/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh"' >> /root/.bashrc && \
    echo 'source "/root/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh"' >> /root/.profile

# Install JVM tools via sdkman
RUN bash -c "source /root/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh && \
    sdk install java 8.0.412-zulu && \
    sdk install java 11.0.23-tem && \
    sdk install java 17.0.11-tem && \
    sdk install java 21.0.3-tem && \
    sdk default java 17.0.11-tem && \
    sdk install maven && \
    sdk install gradle && \
    sdk install kotlin"

# Set JAVA_HOME, add all tools to PATH
ENV JAVA_HOME="/root/.sdkman/candidates/java/current"
ENV PATH="/root/.sdkman/candidates/java/current/bin:/root/.sdkman/candidates/maven/current/bin:/root/.sdkman/candidates/gradle/current/bin:/root/.sdkman/candidates/kotlin/current/bin:${PATH}"

    cd $ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools && \
    curl -o sdk.zip https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-11076708_latest.zip && \

    yes | $ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --sdk_root=$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT "platform-tools" "platforms;android-34"

    sdk default java 11.0.23-tem"

problem_statement:
Introduce new managed transaction methods and deprecate existing ones (#1196)

* Introduce new managed transaction methods and deprecate existing ones

This update introduces new methods for managed transactions, also known as transaction functions. Furthermore, it deprecates the existing methods.

The new methods are:
- `executeRead` (synchronous and reactive), `executeReadAsync` (asynchronous)
- `executeWrite` (synchronous and reactive), `executeWriteAsync` (asynchronous)
- `executeWriteWithoutResult` (synchronous)

There are overloaded options that take transaction configuration.

The new methods do not permit explicit management (commit, rollback, close) of managed transaction. The driver will attempt committing the transaction as long as the provided unit of work completes successfully.

FROM ubuntu:22.04

ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

ENV GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null"

# Install dependencies
RUN apt-get update -y && \
    apt-get upgrade -y && \
    apt-get install -y software-properties-common curl zip unzip build-essential git && \
    apt-get clean && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Install sdkman
RUN curl -s "https://get.sdkman.io" | bash

# Ensure sdkman is sourced in all shells
RUN echo 'source "/root/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh"' >> /root/.bashrc && \
    echo 'source "/root/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh"' >> /root/.profile

# Install JVM tools via sdkman
RUN bash -c "source /root/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh && \
    sdk install java 8.0.412-zulu && \
    sdk install java 11.0.23-tem && \
    sdk install java 17.0.11-tem && \
    sdk install java 21.0.3-tem && \
    sdk default java 17.0.11-tem && \
    sdk install maven && \
    sdk install gradle && \
    sdk install kotlin"

# Set JAVA_HOME, add all tools to PATH
ENV JAVA_HOME="/root/.sdkman/candidates/java/current"
ENV PATH="/root/.sdkman/candidates/java/current/bin:/root/.sdkman/candidates/maven/current/bin:/root/.sdkman/candidates/gradle/current/bin:/root/.sdkman/candidates/kotlin/current/bin:${PATH}"

# Install Android SDK commandline-tools and basic packages
ENV ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="/opt/android-sdk"
ENV PATH="$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:$PATH"

RUN mkdir -p $ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools && \
    cd $ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools && \
    curl -o sdk.zip https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-11076708_latest.zip && \
    unzip sdk.zip -d . && \
    mv cmdline-tools latest && \
    rm sdk.zip && \
    yes | $ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --sdk_root=$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT "platform-tools" "platforms;android-34"

RUN bash -c "rm patch.diff"

problem_statement:
Add support for multiple certificate files (#1153)

* Add support for multiple certificate files

This update brings support for specifying multiple certificate files via `TrustStrategy#trustCustomCertificateSignedBy(File...)`. Also, it deprecates `TrustStrategy#certFiles()` that is superseded by `TrustStrategy#certFiles()`.

In addition, it adds support for the following Testkit feature flags:
- `Feature:API:SSLConfig`
- `Detail:DefaultSecurityConfigValueEquality`

* Updated certFiles management
